title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-98-24一模

items.zh: 小区里的咖啡店定于年底开张，这真是锦上添花的美事。
items.en: The café in the community is scheduled to open at the end of the year, which is truly the icing on the cake.

items.zh: 我们都没有想到，那个曾经腼腆的男孩竟然能在演讲比赛中一举夺魁。
items.en: It never occurred to us that the boy who used to be shy won first prize in the speech contest.

items.zh: 很多人反对在岛上修建核电站, 担心废水可能会排入海洋，污染海洋生物。
items.en: Many people oppose the construction of a nuclear power plant on the island for fear that waste water may be released into the ocean and harm marine life.

items.zh: 除了推出智能电子产品外,这个公司与客户深化合作,探索数字化转型和可持续发展的道路。
items.en: In addition to launching smart electronic products, the company deepens its cooperation with customers to explore the path of digital transformation and sustainable development.
